newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SMI to include Ciba Specialty Chemicals.
newsitem.headline: SMI to include Ciba Specialty Chemicals.

text.p: Ciba Specialty Chemicals, a company formed by a spin-off from Novartis AG, will be included in the Swiss Market Index (SMI), the Swiss Exchange said.

The Swiss Exchange, the management body of the Swiss electronic stock exchange and the SOFFEX futures and options exchange, said it was the first time it had moved so quickly to integrate a new share into the index.

The Ciba Specialty spin-off is billed as the largest transaction of its kind on the Swiss bourse. It begins next week when the company will announce its minimum share price offering in Swiss newspapers on Wednesday, February 26.
The subscription rights will be traded on the bourse starting the same day.
Prior to the completion of the share sale, subscription rights will be included in the SMI.

The Ciba Specialty shares will begin bourse trade after pricing and allocation is completed on March 13. Subscription rights can be exchanged for Ciba Specialty shares for a "paid in par" fee of 10 francs after the subscription rights expire at the end of the two week period.
The Swiss Exchange said that options trade on Novartis shares minus subscription rights will begin on February 26.
Long- and short-term options will also be launched on Ciba Specialty shares with the start of trade in the cash underlying share on March 13.

Ciba Specialty said February 18 that it expects an initial price range for offering of 72 to 86 Swiss francs per registered share, and it expects to offer a minimum 300 million Swiss francs worth of shares.
Some market participants said the price of the new shares was already quoted higher off-exchange.
